Pilot an Market project that connects actors under A to Z initiative or Farm2Market project The Farm2Market pilot component of the HBP project was led by Holland GreenTech. This component was aimed to establish demonstration farms, strengthen farmer capacity through agronomy support, and link horticulture SMEs and youth to market-driven production models. The Farm2Market project aimed at creating direct farm to feed the market with the involvement of market in the production by producing to meet market preference and volumes requirement. The project started with needs assessment and scouting of appropriate lead farmers that meet the criteria, HGT commenced field visits conducted on-site assessments and inspected farms. The off-taker for the Farm2Market project was Edern Tree company and other premium buyers.
